reviews.t: Great product but the brush had an issue
reviews.x: Overall, quality product for the price. The scissors aren’t too sharp, but I can fix that. The packaging was very nice quality and would make a great gift. The comb is high quality and smells fantastic. The brush is missing an entire little section of bristles. It’s annoying, and I wish I hadn’t had this issue, but I will still hold onto the product because everything else is high quality.

Thought this would be a fun gift for my boyfriend who has a large beard but wasn’t really expecting much. It works so well! There’s a very noticeable difference after he brushes, it looks great and much neater

reviews.t: Date a bearded man, they have the patience to put up with you.
reviews.x: This men's grooming kit was bought for my very bearded husband... His beard can easily become the "catch-all" if he isn't careful. The brush and comb are very sturdy. Even for the most masculine of men. This ain't for sissies. The scissors are cute... but in a good way. They're also of good quality. It also comes with a gift box and a nice bag... which our daughters promptly stole upon opening the box... they can't be trusted. If you're a bearded man, or you love a bearded man, do him a

Awesome set.  That's all I can say lol!  The comb is perfect and doesn't snag your facial hair (even course hair such as mine), the brush is great and does it's job 100% and the scissors are VERY nice for trimming.  Worth every penny.  The bag is just a bonus but it's great to store them in so they don't get lost and the bag will also wick any moisture out of the items inside of it to prevent any mildew or rust (on the scissors).

I can only give 2 stars at the boar bristle on the beard brush sheds greatly. The first time I used it, I would say there were at 5-10 bristles on my beard and sink. The next day there were more. The scissors and comb are nice but I was really looking for a good brush so I can not recommend due to the quality of the brush.

reviews.t: Great quality. The wood has a great smell and ...
reviews.x: Great quality. The wood has a great smell and the comb and brush are very sturdy. The scissors are just OK. They get the job done but they're not as sharp as I had hoped. Still, a great value for your dollar!
just started growing my beard out for the first time and this was a great help. Just add some beard oil to the mix and you are ready to be a well groomed man.

reviews.t: Good for the price; Excellent for beginning beardsmen.
reviews.x: I received this kit as a gift for Christmas ('17). This is the "new" version of the bundle on Amazon. The brush is much softer than I expected and is very smooth as it moves through my beard. The comb looks good, darker grain, but a few of the teeth are warped. It works without snagging but it was a little disappointing when first unboxed. The scissors look cool, like something a hipster would use in a movie. Right up until you try to use them. One of the blades are either bent or warped

reviews.t: Great quality set, perfect for gift giving.
reviews.x: I bought this for my dad who has spent months in the hospital following a massive stroke, unable to do any of his own personal care. He has a mustache and long beard. I use this set to comb and trim his mustache and brush his beard. He loves the way it feels and the scissors work great. I also gifted a set to my step-dad and he loves it as well. Great quality! The comb, brush, and scissors all feel sturdy and well made.

This is an ok brush, scissor, comb set. The brush isn’t as stiff as I would like  but it is good for a short beard as it’s easier on your skin. The scissors are small but sharp good for light trims of flyaway hairs. The comb is well made and is great for getting through my long beard. It’s a nice set and for the money well made . I would purchase again.

For my first ever set, pretty damn good. I am glad I took a risk on it. I’ve used it for a little over a month, I started noticing the loosening of my beard after a few days. I finally had the courage to use the scissors and trimmed up the sides a little bit and they are pretty smooth.

reviews.t: He sat and just brushed his beard with the brush when I first gave it to him because it felt so nice. Helps keep his bea
reviews.x: Fiance loves it! Bought it to control is mountain man beard. He sat and just brushed his beard with the brush when I first gave it to him because it felt so nice. Helps keep his beard from getting too "Cthulhu" as he describes it.

reviews.t: Great quality for a great price!
reviews.x: Surprised my husband with this and he loves it. It doesn’t look cheap or feel like it will snap in half. Has a cute bag to keep everything together and has helped my husband so much. No more paying for the barber to trim his beard.
This was a gift for my Brother. I opebed the box and with inspectionThe scissors arrives stained and sticky :(  the Brush is 👎🏼
The scissors stick when using (the metal hits itself). The brush bristles are softer than expected. The wooden brush is ok.
The brush is great, all good quality. Really happy with this purchase. My husband likes it.
Perfect for my starter beard, high quality, great price
Great product! Quality has proven excellent so far.

Ive had it for years now no rusty or bristles falling out. That being said I wipe mine clean after every use. The bristles appear to be real as over time I've added many oils and they seem to build up on the bristles because they don't get absorbed (fake or plastic bristles maybe)? That being said I really still enjoy the item Ive had it for 3 years scissors are sharp. I will probably try and get a better boar brush.  No real problems like many others have mentioned.

Searched all over the internet for a set like this that could but customized or engraved but could not find one. I saw this set and felt like for the price maybe I could take it somewhere and have it engraved since there are not any emblems or brand names on it. It came in the cutest little gift box and was prefect for what I was looking for. I did end up taking it to a local wood engraver and having  it customized and it made for the perfect gift.

reviews.t: Great kit except for an odd smell...
reviews.x: It's a great kit as far as the components. The brush is a bit more stiff than some of the others that I've tried but that's a good thing as far as I am concerned because it penetrates through my thick beard.  The only reason that I gave it 3 stars instead of 5 is due to a strong strange scent that all of the pieces have. I am unsure if this was just a fluke and was on the kit that I received but other than that one flaw it is great.

reviews.t: The brush was perfect for grooming his beard
reviews.x: At first I thought, did I really just buy embroidery scissors and a horse grooming brush? But then the brush ended up being perfect for grooming his beard. He trimmed his mustache in 3 seconds with the scissors. The only thing I think should change is the canvas drawstring bag should have a logo on it for future brand recognition. The product itself is fabulous.

reviews.t: do not buy for actual scissor use
reviews.x: I bought this set bc I needed a new pair of beard scissors and this felt like a good deal with the added brush/comb.  The scissors, while beautiful, do not work at all.  They are unbelievably dull and pretty much useless.  I’m holding onto the set, and adding a second star to my rating, bc the scissors are nice to look at and the brush was surprisingly nice.

Great set for the price, the brush and comb feel great against your beard and makes it feel very smooth. The scissors are also small and compact which makes getting those pesky wild hairs very easy, and feels comfortable in your hand. Also the carry bag is a great addition. Overall this set is well worth the price and would recommend to friends.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the set as great quality and good value for the price.
The comb and brush are commonly described as sturdy and effective at grooming beards without snagging.
Several reviewers find the scissors only okay or not as sharp as hoped, though some say they work well for light trims.
Some reviewers report problems with the brush, including missing bristles or shedding bristles.
Many reviewers say the set makes a great gift and is well received by recipients.
